strings.name: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
strings.summary: Leung moved from Hong Kong television training into cinema, collaborating with Wong Kar-wai, Hou Hsiao-hsien, Ang Lee and Zhang Yimou. His restrained performances explore emotion and contradiction. In the Mood for Love won him Cannes’ acting prize, while Infernal Affairs and Hero broadened his genre work. He also appeared in Hollywood and received Venice’s lifetime-achievement Golden Lion in 2023. His international film exchanges continued in 2026.

strings.influence.rationale: Performances in In the Mood for Love, Infernal Affairs and other works built his international reputation as an important representative of Hong Kong cinema and Chinese-language screen acting.
